name: infra-plan-readback
title: Infra Plan Readback
description: Reads a `terraform show -json` plan as create, update, replace and destroy counts, lists stateful destroys and replacements first with the attribute forcing each, and keeps Apply locked until each loss is acknowledged (and, in production, the workspace typed).

meta.stops: Helps prevent terraform apply destroying a production database
meta.summary: Reads a Terraform or OpenTofu plan back with data-losing destroys and replacements first, so an apply doesn't quietly delete a production database.
meta.server: Protect production state with policy checks (OPA/Sentinel), prevent_destroy and deletion protection, and require reviewed plans in CI.
catches: Destroys and replacements of databases, buckets, volumes and keys, listed first
The attribute that forces a replacement (before → after, sensitive values hidden)
Destroy-before-create replacements that leave a gap
Production workspace, or var.environment saying production when the workspace doesn't
limits: Only as good as the plan JSON; a plan made against stale state or a different workspace isn't detected
Stateful detection uses a built-in type list plus your statefulTypes/isStateful
The lock is in this UI; terraform apply from a terminal or CI is not affected
a11y: Parse errors and unappliable plans use role=alert
Data-loss list is a labelled section with a checkbox label per item
Workspace confirmation input has a visible label
Status uses role=status; sign icons are aria-hidden with the action named in text
